description: Source code implementing PC1 cipher encryption/decryption utility with command-line interface, handling file input/output, and key management.

methods.name: pc1_finish
methods.description: Clears all variables in the PC1 context to erase sensitive data.

methods.name: pc1_code
methods.description: Performs core cipher transformation on the PC1 context.

methods.name: pc1_assemble
methods.description: Assembles key schedule from the key array in the PC1 context.

methods.name: pc1_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a single byte using PC1 cipher.

methods.name: pc1_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a single byte using PC1 cipher.

methods.name: pc1_init
methods.description: Initializes the PC1 context with default key.
